title: Evaluate: should GlobalHalal move production abroad?
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 50 (Pupil PDF worksheet: own exam-style questions, case data and mark-scheme points (teacher-written))
intro: Lesson 50. Use the data and the stakeholder map. All businesses, people and figures in these cases are fictional, made up for practice.

passage.title: GlobalHalal plc: relocation
paras: GlobalHalal plc makes halal snacks and sells them in 11 countries. It is a public limited company with 2,400 employees. Over the last year it has expanded into three new countries and opened a larger factory in Leicester.

The board is considering moving production from Leicester to a factory in Malaysia. Unit cost in Leicester is £2.10; in Malaysia it would be £1.50, plus £0.20 transport to the UK. Closing the Leicester factory would end 400 jobs. Malaysia has a well-established halal certification system.

questions.q: Evaluate whether GlobalHalal should move production to Malaysia.
questions.a: Level-marked (12): unit cost falls by £0.40 (19%) so profit rises; nearer Asian markets; vs 400 job losses, reputation and ethics, transport risk, quality control; judgement weighs stakeholders.

frame.label: For: point and chain of reasoning in context
Against: point and chain of reasoning in context
Judgement: decide, give the main reason, say what it depends on

markScheme.a: Level 4 (10-12): developed chains on both sides in context and a supported judgement with 'it depends on'. Level 3 (7-9): both sides developed, judgement partly supported. Level 2 (4-6): some development, one-sided or generic. Level 1 (1-3): points identified.
